MAPICON_BUILD_RECRUIT_TT.en: Recruiting $NAME|Y$ which will be finished at $WHEN|Y$.

MAPICON_BUILD_SHIP_TT.en: Building $VAL|Y$ of a possible [LOCATION.GetModifierValue('max_ships_built_at_same_time')] [ships|e] in parallel.\n$DETAILS$

NO_LEADER_TT.en:
#T No Commander#!
This Unit has no Commander

$CLICK_TO_SELECT$

PORT_NO_VISIBILITY.en: We do not know if there are ships stationed at this [port|e].
PORT_NO_VISIBILITY.uk: Ми не знаємо, чи стоять кораблі в цьому [Concept('port','порту')|e].

UNIT_HAS_ARMIES_DISEMBARKING.en: #R This [navy|e] has embarked [armies|e] [disembarking|e], it cannot move at the moment.#!
UNIT_HAS_ARMIES_DISEMBARKING.uk: #R Цей [Concept('navy','флот')|e] не може рухатися, поки з нього [Concept('disembarking','висаджуються')|e] [Concept('armies','армії')|e].#!

UNIT_IS_ON_MOVING_SHIP.en: #R Unit is embarked on a moving [ship|e] and cannot [disembark|e] now.#!
UNIT_IS_ON_MOVING_SHIP.uk: #R Загін перебуває на рухомому [Concept('ship','кораблі')|e] і не може [Concept('disembark','висадитися')|e].#!

UNIT_WILL_ARRIVE_CROSS_RIVER.en: Will cross a river and arrive in $NAME|Y$ on $DATE|Y$

WINTER_BLOCKED_TOOLTIP.en: [LOCATION.GetName] is currently blocked by [winter|e]. Armies cannot enter or pass through this location until winter ends.
WINTER_BLOCKED_TOOLTIP.uk: Район [LOCATION.GetName] наразі заблокований: [winter|e]. Армії не можуть входити в цей район чи проходити крізь нього, доки не скінчиться зима.
